# Satisfactory Heatmap

> Capacity-aware factory location heatmap for the game Satisfactory.
> Free static web tool — not a full production calculator.

## Site

- Homepage: https://satisfactory-heatmap.com/
- Source: https://github.com/TylerR909/satisfactory-heat-map

## What it does

Given raw resource rates (or product targets such as Heavy Modular Frames),
scores the map for where a factory is easiest to feed — distance plus local
extract capacity under the player's miner Mk / clock settings. Supports
Update 1.2+ map seeds (randomized node types/purities on fixed slots).

## How to use

1. Open the site.
2. Mode A: enter raw demand rates, or Mode B: pick products and rates.
3. Adjust extractors and clustering (Centered vs Weighted).
4. Read the live heatmap and top-N site pins; share via URL hash.

## Related tools (not us)

- Production ratios: satisfactorytools.com, KirkMcDonald calculator
- Collectible / interactive maps: SCIM, th.gl

## Notes for agents

- Single-page app; meaningful UI requires JavaScript.
- Plan state lives in the URL hash (`#v1.…`) and is not server-rendered.
- Not affiliated with Coffee Stain Studios.
